name: Fallout Classic Collection
summary: Fallout Classic Collection brings together the iconic role-playing games that laid the foundation for one of the most beloved franchises in gaming history. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, players navigate the wasteland, making critical choices that shape their journey and affect the game's outcome. With a blend of open-world exploration, turn-based combat, and immersive storytelling, this collection delivers a nostalgic yet thoroughly engaging experience, allowing gamers to revisit the origins of humanity's struggle for survival amid nuclear fallout.
